name: Not Forgotten

frame.name: Precision Frame
frame.description: Recoil pattern on this weapon is predictably more vertical. Fires quickly with high accuracy. Move faster while aiming down sights with this weapon equipped.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.description: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Magnificent Howl
perks.description: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

flavor: "Guardians never die. But we don't forget those who do." —Lord Shaxx
